# Turn a 20-page policy into 5 clear points in minutes

**Hook:** You’ll be able to upload any long PDF, click once, and get a concise five-point summary ready for your next meeting or report.

## Before you start
- A free Cohere account (sign-up takes 2 minutes)
- Any PDF file on your device (up to 20 pages)
- A computer or phone with internet and a web browser
- Rough time: 5 minutes total

---

## Step 1 — Open Cohere’s free summariser page
Go to [https://cohere.com/summarize](https://cohere.com/summarize) in your browser. You’ll see a clean page with a big text box and a short instruction line underneath. The page loads quickly and shows a small example prompt (“Summarise this article…”) to show you what to do next. You’ll know it worked when you see the empty text box ready for your PDF or text.

💬 Example:
No typing needed here — just wait for the page to load.

---

## Step 2 — Upload or paste your PDF
Look for a button or link that says “Upload file” or “Choose file” near the text box. Tap it and pick your 20-page policy PDF from your device. If the button isn’t obvious, look for a small cloud icon with an up arrow. After you select the file, the page usually shows the filename and a small preview line. You’ll know it worked when the filename appears under the box and the summariser starts processing.

💬 Example:
Pick “Company_Policy_2025.pdf” from your Downloads folder.

---

## Step 3 — Set the length to “short”
Below the text box you’ll see a small dropdown or slider labelled “Length” or “Summary length”. Choose the shortest option, usually called “Short” or “Bullet points”. This tells the tool to keep the summary tight and focused. If you don’t see a dropdown, look for a small gear or settings icon nearby. You’ll know it worked when the label changes to “Short” and the preview box shrinks.

💬 Example:
Click the dropdown and pick “Short”.

---

## Step 4 — Click “Summarise” and wait
Find the blue or green button labelled “Summarise”, “Generate”, or “Create summary” under the box. Tap it once. The page will show a spinning circle or progress bar while the AI reads your PDF and extracts the key points. On the free plan this usually takes 10–30 seconds for a 20-page document. You’ll know it worked when the spinning circle stops and a new box appears with your bullet points.

💬 Example:
Click the big blue “Summarise” button.

---

## Step 5 — Copy the five bullet points
The new box will display a numbered list of short sentences or bullet points. Each point is usually one sentence long and covers a main idea from the policy. If the list has more than five points, you can manually pick the five most important ones for your meeting. If the points look too long, look for a small “Copy” button or highlight the text and press Ctrl+C (Cmd+C on Mac). You’ll know it worked when you have five clear sentences on your clipboard ready to paste.

💬 Example:
1. Purpose and scope defined
2. Roles and responsibilities assigned
3. Compliance requirements listed
4. Reporting procedures outlined
5. Review cycle set to annual

---

## Step 6 — Paste into your notes or slide
Open your meeting notes, slide deck, or document where you need the summary. Click in the text area and press Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on Mac) to paste the five bullet points. If your tool doesn’t accept plain text, paste into a simple text editor first, then copy again to remove any hidden formatting. You’ll know it worked when you see the five clean bullet points in your document.

💬 Example:
Paste the five points under “Key takeaways” in your slide.

---

## Common mistakes
- **Uploading the wrong file** — double-check the filename after you pick it; if it’s not your policy, click the “X” or “Remove” button and try again.
- **Choosing the wrong length** — if the summary is still too long, go back to Step 3 and pick “Short” again before regenerating.
- **Copying extra text** — only highlight and copy the bullet points; avoid copying the “Generated by Cohere” footer line.

---

## What this means for you
- **In everyday life:** Keep a folder of long PDFs on your computer? Use this trick to turn any policy, contract, or manual into a quick cheat-sheet before a meeting.
- **For your business or work:** Need to share a 20-page guideline with your team? Paste the five bullet points into a Slack message or email instead of the whole file.
- **If you're just getting started:** Start with a short PDF you already understand; once you see how the tool works, try it on longer or trickier documents.

---

## Try it now
Open [https://cohere.com/summarize](https://cohere.com/summarize), upload any short PDF you have on your device, set the length to “Short”, click “Summarise”, and copy the first five bullet points into a new note.
